## Manual aggregation (Stochastic data)

-   1\) aggregate EWR versions \> gauges \> planning units = sdl_EWR_spells

-   2\) aggregate EWR versions \> EWRs \> gauges \> planning units = sdl_target_spells

-   calculate: ewr achieved, Maximum_interevent_duration, Variance

```{r}
# DATA
# flow chart?
# need intermediate steps?
# baseline_compare {werptoolkitr]

#------
#QAEL - WERP in house - WERP/Toolkit/macq-data-no_climate_change/aggregator_output/EWR_timeseries.csv"
EWR_timing_timeseries <- read.csv(file.path(hydro_dir_stochastic, 'aggregator_output', 'EWR_timeseries.csv')) |>
    #switch CFs:
  dplyr::mutate(event_years = ifelse(grepl("CF", ewr_code), 1-event_years, event_years))

EWR_timing_timeseries$ewr_code <- factor(EWR_timing_timeseries$ewr_code, levels = c("CF", "VF", "BF1", "BF2", "SF1", "SF2", "SF3", "LF1", "LF2", "OB-WL", "OB-WM", "OB-WS1", "OB-WS2", "OB-WS3", "OB-WS4")) 


objective_mapping <- read.csv(file.path(qaelpath, 'Toolkit','CausalNetworks', 'EWR_to_Target_mapping.csv'))
objective_mapping$ewr_code <- factor(objective_mapping$ewr_code, levels = c("CF", "VF", "BF1", "BF2", "SF1", "SF2", "SF3", "LF1", "LF2", "OB-WL", "OB-WM", "OB-WS1", "OB-WS2", "OB-WS3", "OB-WS4")) 


# Join scenario info
#-------------------
#Add temporarily the scenario info for NOW ONLY 
EWR_timing_timeseries <- EWR_timing_timeseries |>
  dplyr::mutate(Rainfall = as.numeric(1.0),
                Evapotranspiration = as.numeric(1.0),
                licvolfactor = as.numeric(1.0),
                Mk = as.character("Mk4"),
                Data = "Stochastic")

# Calculate Max inter-event durations
#------------------------------------
gauge_EWR_timing_spells <- EWR_timing_timeseries |>
  group_by(scenario, ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)|>
  dplyr::mutate(event_group = cumsum(abs(c(0, diff(event_years)))),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved, na.rm = TRUE))|>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name, event_group)|>
  dplyr::mutate(event_group_n = n())|>
  dplyr::filter(event_years == 0)|>
  ungroup()|>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(ewr_achieved = unique(ewr_achieved),  #this is right - saves making 2 separate dfs for ewr_achieved and interevent
          Maximum_interevent_duration = max(event_group_n))

# obbective mapping: 
#-----------------------------------
#Target data timeseries
EWR_timing_target_timeseries <- EWR_timing_timeseries |>
  mutate(gauge = as.character(gauge)) |>
  left_join(objective_mapping, by = join_by(ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)) |>
  rename(env_group = target)|>
  mutate(target = case_when(      env_group == "NF" ~ "Native fish",
                                  env_group == "NV" ~ "Native vegetation" ,
                                  env_group == "OS" ~ "Other species",   
                                  env_group == "EF" ~ "Priority ecosystem function", 
                                  env_group == "WB" ~ "Waterbird",
                                  env_group == NA ~ NA))

#TIME aggregated
gauge_EWR_timing_target_spells <- gauge_EWR_timing_spells |>
  mutate(gauge = as.character(gauge)) |>
  left_join(objective_mapping, by = join_by(ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)) |>
  rename(env_group = target)|>
  mutate(target = case_when(      env_group == "NF" ~ "Native fish",
                                  env_group == "NV" ~ "Native vegetation" ,
                                  env_group == "OS" ~ "Other species",   
                                  env_group == "EF" ~ "Priority ecosystem function", 
                                  env_group == "WB" ~ "Waterbird",
                                  env_group == NA ~ NA))

#aggregate EWR versions
#----------------------
#EWR data timeseries
gauge_EWR_timeseries <- EWR_timing_timeseries |>
  group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, gauge, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = n(),
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#Target data timeseries
gauge_EWR_target_timeseries <- EWR_timing_target_timeseries |>
  group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, gauge, planning_unit_name, env_group,
                   target)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = n(),
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#EWR data (time aggregated)
gauge_EWR_spells <- gauge_EWR_timing_spells |>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, gauge, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = n(),
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
          mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(Maximum_interevent_duration),
          Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

#Target data (time aggregated)
gauge_EWR_target_spells <- gauge_EWR_timing_target_spells |>
          group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, gauge, planning_unit_name, env_group,
                   target)|>
          reframe(n_EWR_versions = n(),
                  ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
                  mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(Maximum_interevent_duration),
                  Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))
      
#aggregate EWRS to Target
#----------------------
#Target data timeseries
gauge_target_timeseries <- gauge_EWR_target_timeseries |>
        group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  gauge, planning_unit_name, 
                 env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Variance(ewr_achieved), # Variance = between EWRs
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#Target data (time aggregated)
gauge_target_spells <- gauge_EWR_target_spells |>
        group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  gauge, planning_unit_name, env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Variance(ewr_achieved), # Variance = between EWRs
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
                mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration),
                Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

#aggregate gauges
#----------------------- 
#EWR timeseries
planning_unit_EWR_timeseries <- gauge_EWR_timeseries |>
  group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
          n_gauges = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
          EWR_Variance = Variance(ewr_achieved), # Variance = between gauges
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#Target timeseries
planning_unit_target_timeseries <- gauge_target_timeseries |>
        group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  planning_unit_name, env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = Sum(n_EWRs),
                n_gauges = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#EWR data
planning_unit_EWR_spells <- gauge_EWR_spells |>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
          n_gauges = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
          EWR_Variance = Variance(ewr_achieved), # Variance = between gauges
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
          mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration),
          Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

#Target data
planning_unit_target_spells <- gauge_target_spells |>
        group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  planning_unit_name, env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = Sum(n_EWRs),
                n_gauges = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
                mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration),
                Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

#aggregate planning units - ONLY have one sdl 
#--------------------------------------------
#EWR timeseries 
sdl_EWR_timeseries <- planning_unit_EWR_timeseries |>
  group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
          n_gauges = Sum(n_gauges),
          n_planning_units = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
          EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))

#Target timeseries
sdl_target_timeseries <- planning_unit_target_timeseries |>
        group_by(year, scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = Sum(n_EWRs),
                n_gauges = Sum(n_gauges),
                n_planning_units = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved))
      
#EWR data - irrespective of Targets 
sdl_EWR_spells <- planning_unit_EWR_spells |>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code)|>
  reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
          n_gauges = Sum(n_gauges),
          n_planning_units = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
          EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
          ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
          mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration),
          Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

#Target data
      sdl_target_spells <- planning_unit_target_spells |>
        group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  env_group, target)|>
        reframe(n_EWR_versions = Sum(n_EWR_versions),
                n_EWRs = Sum(n_EWRs),
                n_gauges = Sum(n_gauges),
                n_planning_units = NumberOfValues(ewr_achieved),
                EWR_Variance = Sum(EWR_Variance),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved),
                mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = mean(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration),
                Maximum_interevent_duration = max(Maximum_interevent_duration))

```

## Manual aggregation (Historic data)

-   1\) aggregate EWR versions \> gauges \> planning units = sdl_EWR_spells

-   2\) aggregate EWR versions \> EWRs \> gauges \> planning units = sdl_target_spells

-   calculate: ewr achieved, Maximum_interevent_duration, Variance

```{r}
# DATA
#------
#"C:/Users/Admin/Deakin University/QAEL - WERP in house - WERP/Toolkit/macq-data/historic/Mk4"

EWR_timing_timeseries_MK4 <- read.csv(file.path(Mk4_dir, "aggregator_output", 'EWR_timeseries.csv'))|>
    #switch CFs:
  dplyr::mutate(event_years = ifelse(grepl("CF", ewr_code), 1-event_years, event_years)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(EWR_switch = ifelse(grepl("CF", ewr_code), T, F))
  
EWR_timing_timeseries_MK4$ewr_code <- factor(EWR_timing_timeseries_MK4$ewr_code, levels = c("CF", "VF", "BF1", "BF2", "SF1", "SF2", "SF3", "LF1", "LF2", "OB-WL", "OB-WM", "OB-WS1", "OB-WS2", "OB-WS3", "OB-WS4")) 


objective_mapping <- read.csv(file.path(qaelpath, 'Toolkit','CausalNetworks', 'EWR_to_Target_mapping.csv'))
objective_mapping$ewr_code <- factor(objective_mapping$ewr_code, levels = c("CF", "VF", "BF1", "BF2", "SF1", "SF2", "SF3", "LF1", "LF2", "OB-WL", "OB-WM", "OB-WS1", "OB-WS2", "OB-WS3", "OB-WS4"))


# Join scenario info
#-------------------
#Add temporarily the scenario info for NOW ONLY 
EWR_timing_timeseries_MK4 <- EWR_timing_timeseries_MK4 |>
  dplyr::rename(Rainfall = rainfall,
                Evapotranspiration = evapotranspiration,
                #licvolfactor = as.numeric(1.0),
                Mk = mk)|>
  dplyr::mutate(Data = "Historic")

# Calculate Max inter-event durations
#------------------------------------
gauge_EWR_timing_spells_MK4 <- EWR_timing_timeseries_MK4 |>
  group_by(scenario, ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)|>
  dplyr::mutate(event_group = cumsum(abs(c(0, diff(event_years)))),
                ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved, na.rm = TRUE))|>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name, event_group)|>
  dplyr::mutate(event_group_n = n())|>
  dplyr::filter(event_years == 0)|>
  ungroup()|>
  group_by(scenario, Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)|>
  reframe(ewr_achieved = unique(ewr_achieved),  #this is right - saves making 2 separate dfs for ewr_achieved and interevent
          Maximum_interevent_duration = max(event_group_n))

# obbective mapping: 
#-----------------------------------
#Target data timeseries
EWR_timing_target_timeseries_MK4 <- EWR_timing_timeseries_MK4 |>
  mutate(gauge = as.character(gauge)) |>
  left_join(objective_mapping, by = join_by(ewr_code, ewr_code_timing, gauge, planning_unit_name)) |>
```

## Calculate confidence intervals for CDF

```{r}
sdl_EWR_ecdf <- sdl_EWR_timeseries|>
  ungroup()|>
  select(-year)|>
  group_by(Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, scenario)|> #YES SCENARIO!
  mutate(ewr_achieved_group = round(ewr_achieved, 2))|>
  arrange(ewr_achieved)|>  
  mutate(ecdf_val = ecdf(ewr_achieved)(ewr_achieved))|>
  tibble()|>
  ungroup()|>
  group_by(Rainfall, Evapotranspiration, licvolfactor, Mk, Data,  ewr_code, ewr_achieved_group)|> #NOT SCENARIO!
  mutate(ecdf_mean = mean(ecdf_val),
         cdf_lsd = ecdf_mean - 2*sd(ecdf_val),
         cdf_usd = ecdf_mean + 2*sd(ecdf_val))

# 
# temp <- quantreg::rq(sdl_EWR_timeseries, tau = 0.95)
# quantile(95)
```

## Adjusting stochastic results to have median = to historic

```{r}
 sdl_EWR_spells_adjusted <-  sdl_EWR_spells |>
   #filter(names_CSIRO_climate_scenario != "Historical climate")|>
   left_join(sdl_EWR_spells_MK4_historic, by = "ewr_code")|>
   group_by(ewr_code)|>
   mutate(median_ewr_achieved = median(ewr_achieved))|>
   mutate(adj_ewr_achieved = ewr_achieved - (median_ewr_achieved-historic_ewr_achieved))
 
 sdl_target_spells_adjusted <-  sdl_target_spells |>
   #filter(names_CSIRO_climate_scenario != "Historical climate")|>
   left_join(sdl_target_spells_MK4_historic, by = "env_group")|>
   group_by(env_group)|>
   mutate(median_ewr_achieved = median(ewr_achieved))|>
   mutate(adj_ewr_achieved = ewr_achieved - (median_ewr_achieved-historic_ewr_achieved))
```

## Hydrographs

```{r}
#| label: fig-ewr-example
#| fig-cap: !expr glue::glue("EWR are illustrated at two example gauges ({paste0(gauges_to_plot, collapse = ' and ')}) on the historical base level (scenario E1) hydrographs. See @sec-ewr-table for a table.")

#Hydrographs- just read in the ones we use
scenehydros <- read_hydro(hydro_dir,
                          # scenariofilter = "historical_scale_rain_1_2_evap_1_0_licvolfactor_1_5_0",
                          long = TRUE, format = 'nc') 

#Scenario names have change - this is a work around. hopefully in future the metadata, hydrographs, and EWR outputs match.
scenehydros$scenario <- stringr::str_match(scenehydros$scenario, '(.*)_(.*)')[, -1][,1]

scenehydros <- left_join(scenehydros, scenarios, by = 'scenario')

# # This relies on the NSW ewr definitions. We could keep passing them around, but better to pull from py-ewr directly
pdi <- reticulate::import("py_ewr.data_inputs")

# The second is 'bad', so just get the first
ewrs_in_pyewr <- pdi$get_EWR_table()[[1]]

NSWEWR_gauge <- filter(ewrs_in_pyewr, Gauge %in% gauges_to_plot) |>
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols = Code, delim = '_',
                              names = c("Code", "Timing"),
                              too_few = 'align_start',
                              too_many = 'merge') |>
  rename(gauge = Gauge) |>
  group_by(gauge) %>%
  distinct(Code, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(FlowThresholdMin = as.numeric(FlowThresholdMin)) |>
  arrange(FlowThresholdMin) %>%
  mutate(Date = seq(from = max(scenehydros$Date),
                    to = min(scenehydros$Date),
                    length.out = n())) %>%
  ungroup()

```

## ODD gauges

```{r}

NSWEWR_ODD_gauges <- filter(ewrs_in_pyewr, Gauge %in% ODD_gauges) |>
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols = Code, delim = '_',
                              names = c("Code", "Timing"),
                              too_few = 'align_start',
                              too_many = 'merge') |>
  rename(gauge = Gauge) |>
  group_by(gauge) %>%
  distinct(Code, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(FlowThresholdMin = as.numeric(FlowThresholdMin)) |>

  mutate(Date = seq(from = max(scenehydros$Date),
                    to = min(scenehydros$Date),
                    length.out = n())) %>%
  ungroup()

scenehydros_ODD_gauges <- scenehydros |>
    dplyr::filter(scenario %in% "historical_scale_rain_1_2_evap_1_0_licvolfactor_1_5_0" & 
                  gauge %in% ODD_gauges)

hydro_plot_EWRs <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = scenehydros_ODD_gauges, ggplot2::aes(x = Date, y = (flow/1000) + 1)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(data = NSWEWR_ODD_gauges,
                        mapping = aes(yintercept = (FlowThresholdMin/1000) + 1),
                        colour = "red")+ #
    ggplot2::geom_line() +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(gauge ~ names_scenario , scales = 'free') +
    ggplot2::labs(y = paste0("Flow (GL/day +1)")) +
    theme_werp_toolkit(legend.position = "bottom") +
      guides(colour=guide_legend(nrow=2,byrow=TRUE)) +
    ggplot2::geom_label(data = NSWEWR_ODD_gauges,
                        mapping = aes(x = Date, y = (FlowThresholdMin/1000)+1,
                                      label = Code), size = 3, colour = "black") +
  # tempted to use 'pseudo_log' and not add 1, but the ticks aren't as nice
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(trans = 'log10',
                              sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . , name = "Gauge ID",
                                                  breaks = NULL, labels = NULL))
```

## bar plots - climate-comparison - without adaptation

```{r}
#| label: fig-sdl-comparison

# Scenario comparison for different Sustainable Diversion Limit areas. This example shows the mean proportion of environmental watering requirements (EWRs) that are achieved under each scenario for each SDL unit. This approach illuminates broad-brush differences between scenarios and geographic locations, but does not address which EWRs may be more important to environmental assets or which assets are more sensitive to particular scenarios. Climate scenarios and adaptation options as in @tbl-scenarios. Panels a and b illustrate the same data with a emphasizing quantititive differences and b emphasizing spatial patterns.

#| message: false

# The bars
sdl_achieve_bars_climate_NoAdaptation <- sdl_units_nonrounding |> 
  filter(scenario %in% climate = "MAX") |> 
  mutate(scenario = paste0(licvolfactor)) |> 
  plot_outcomes(outcome_col = 'ewr_achieved',
                outcome_lab = 'Proportion\nEWR achieved',
                x_col = 'scenario',
                x_lab = 'Adaptation option scenario (Change in Licence volume)',
                colorset = 'names_climate_scenario',
                color_lab = 'Climate scenario:',
                pal_list = pal_climate_scenario  |> setNames(stringr::str_replace(names(pal_climate_scenario ), '–', '-\n')),
                position = 'dodge',
                setLimits = c(0,1)) +
  # guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow=2, label.position = 'top')) +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom')



#MANUAL_sdl_achieve_bars_climate_nonrounding + 

sdl_achieve_bars_climate_nonrounding 

ggsave(plot = sdl_achieve_bars_climate_NoAdaptation, filename = file.path(comp_results, "sdl_achieve_bars_climate_NoAdaptation.tiff"), device = "tiff",
       width = 7, height = 6)
```

```{r}
## | label: fig-obj_in_groups
## | fig-cap: "Proportion of EWRs achieved for each environmental objective, grouped into broader environmental groups (EF = Priority Ecosystem Function, NF = Native Fish, NV = Native Vegetation, OS = Other Species, WB = Waterbirds). This view provides an assessment of the performance of individual environmental objectives, as well as how those contribute to the overall sensitivity of the broader groups across space. Not all EWR are applicable in all locations and there are not equal number of EWR in each category. The MAX column illustrates the total number of EWRs for reference, with each black box showing the situation where all EWRs contributing to an Environmental Objective are met. Where the max column does not exist, those objectives are not relevant to that particular planning unit. This illustration includes three climate scenarios: A (0.5x), E (historical base level/no change), and I (2x) and three adaptation options 1 (no adaptation), 2 (+250 ML/d), and 3 (+6500 ML/d)"
```

## End of system flows - adaptation comparison

the current scenarios overlap a lot - but this may be a useful plot with other scenarios.

```{r}
#| label: fig-difference-baseline
#| fig-cap: "Quantitative scenario comparison for Native Fish objectives for three SDL units. Scenarios defined here as the difference in mean flow (GL) from the baseline historical scenario (E1). A key message here is that the lines are not smooth- EWR achievement is not simply a function of the amount of water. Instead, the 'adaptation' options, particularly the '2' scenarios of adding 250 ML/d of water, have disproportionately large impact (steep slopes). Shading indicates different environmental objectives within the native fish target group. This illustration includes three climate scenarios: A (0.5x), E (historical base level/no change), and I (2x) and three adaptation options 1 (no adaptation), 2 (+250 ML/d), and 3 (+6500 ML/d)."
#| message: false

scenarios_end_sys <- sdl_objectives_nonrounding |>
  dplyr::filter(names_climate_scenario %in% MDBA_comparison) |>
  dplyr::filter(scenario != "MAX") |>
  mutate(scenario = names_scenario) |> 
  group_by(scenario, env_group) |>
  mutate(y = 0.45,
         'ewr_achieved' = 0.3,
         pointgroup = 1)

gl_difference <- sdl_objectives_nonrounding |>
  dplyr::filter(scenario != "MAX") |>
    dplyr::filter(names_climate_scenario %in% MDBA_comparison) |>
   mutate(scenario = names_scenario) |> 
  plot_outcomes(outcome_col = 'ewr_achieved',
                outcome_lab = "Proportion EWR achieved",
                x_col = "End sys",
                x_lab = "End of system flow (GL)",
               colorgroups = 'env_group',
               colorset = 'env_obj',
               pal_list = pal_env,
                # base_lev = 'E1',
                # comp_fun = 'difference',
               # group_cols = c('env_obj'),
                color_lab = "Envionmental objectives",
                facet_row = 'env_group',
                facet_col = '.'
                ) +
  ylim(0,1) +
  geom_vline(mapping = aes(xintercept = `End sys`),
             colour = "black", linetype = "solid")+
    guides(colour=guide_legend(ncol=3))+
  facet_grid(env_group~.)

# gl_difference + 
#   geom_text(data = scenarios_end_sys, mapping = aes(label = scenarios_end_sys$scenario, x = scenarios_end_sys$`End sys`, y = scenarios_end_sys$y), size = 3, angle = 90)

header_difference <-  scenarios |> 
    dplyr::filter(names_climate_scenario %in% MDBA_comparison) |>
    dplyr::filter(scenario != "MAX") |>
  mutate(scenario = names_scenario) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = `End sys`,
             y = 1)) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(label = scenario), size = 2.5, angle = 90) +
  theme_werp_toolkit(legend.position = "none", axis.title=element_blank(),
                     axis.text=element_blank(), axis.ticks=element_blank())+
  theme(plot.margin = margin(b = 2))+
  expand_limits(y = c(-6,8))

# put those together
Plot_EndOfSysFlows1 <- header_difference + gl_difference + 
  patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(7,15), guides = "collect") + 
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave(plot = Plot_EndOfSysFlows1, filename = file.path(comp_results, paste0("Objectives_EndOfSysFlows_adaptation_comparison",Sys.Date(),".tiff")), device = "tiff",
       width = 7, height = 4)

```

```{r}
               colorgroups = 'env_group',
               colorset = 'env_obj',
               pal_list = pal_env,
                # base_lev = 'E1',
                # comp_fun = 'difference',
               # group_cols = c('env_obj'),
                color_lab = "Envionmental objectives",
                facet_row = 'env_group',
                facet_col = '.'
                ) +
  ylim(0,1) +
  geom_vline(mapping = aes(xintercept = `End sys`),
             colour = "black", linetype = "solid")+
    guides(colour=guide_legend(ncol=3))+
  facet_grid(env_group~.)

header_difference <-  scenarios |> 
    dplyr::filter(names_climate_scenario %in% MDBA_comparison[2]) |>
    dplyr::filter(scenario != "MAX") |>
  mutate(scenario = names_scenario) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = `End sys`,
             y = 1)) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(label = scenario), size = 2.5, angle = 90) +
  theme_werp_toolkit(legend.position = "none", axis.title=element_blank(),
                     axis.text=element_blank(), axis.ticks=element_blank())+
  theme(plot.margin = margin(b = 2))+
  expand_limits(y = c(-6,8))

# put those together
Plot_EndOfSysFlows4 <- header_difference + gl_difference + 
  patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(7,15), guides = "collect") + 
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave(plot = Plot_EndOfSysFlows4, filename = file.path(comp_results, paste0("Objectives_EndOfSysFlows_DryClimate_adaptation_comparison",Sys.Date(),".tiff")), device = "tiff",
       width = 7, height = 4)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-contour
#| fig-cap: Condition results visualised as a surface with the two scenario definitions on the axes. This approach allows visualising changes in outcome as the result of multiple axes on which scenarios might differ. These axes might be different aspects of scenario creation (as here), or they might be different axes describing the outcome of scenarios (e.g. two different hydrometrics such as mean flow and flow variance)

# This would be better if we had a more even and tighter set of scenarios
contour_heatmap <- agg_envgroup_sdl_to_plot |>
  dplyr::filter(scenario %in% scenarios_scale_evap_climate_comp) |>
  dplyr::filter(env_group != 'EB') |> 
  mutate(scenario = paste0("SE",scale_evap, "_LV",licvolfactor)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = `End sys`, y = `GS Irrig`, z = ewr_achieved)) + 
  geom_tile() + # OR geom_point
  facet_grid(. ~ env_group) +
  geom_contour_filled(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) + 
  theme_werp_toolkit() 

# This is for Galen's reference for developing the function, I think- overlay points and change the fill ramp

# Changing the fill for geom_contour_filled needs bins. The easiest way to make that work from a continuous scale is to get the colors and then use manual.
binpal <- paletteer::paletteer_c('grDevices::Plasma', n = 10)

contour_point_heatmap <- contour_heatmap +
  # Change the fill scale
  scale_fill_manual(values = binpal) +
  # ideally, we'd use the same color ramp and fill these points with a black circle around them. But that conflicts with the binned fill for the contour
  # geom_point(shape = 21, color = 'black')
  geom_point(mapping = aes(color = ewr_achieved)) +
  paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_c('grDevices::Viridis')

contour_heatmap
contour_point_heatmap
```

```{r}

null_data <- data.frame(
  ewr_achieved = seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = 0.01),
  ewr_code = "CF",
  env_group = "NF",
  Data = "Null model")

null_data <- null_data |>
  mutate(n_years_achieved = 130*ewr_achieved,
         n_years_not_achieved = 130*(1-ewr_achieved),
         mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = n_years_not_achieved/n_years_achieved)|>
  mutate(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration = ifelse(mean_Maximum_interevent_duration == Inf, 130, mean_Maximum_interevent_duration))
```
